security_spec.violation_condition: Any QEMU C code implementing Smnip preemption that writes 'iprio & NIPPRIO_MASK >= xithreshold' without explicit parentheses, causing operator precedence to evaluate NIPPRIO_MASK >= xithreshold (producing 0 or 1) before ANDing with iprio, instead of masking iprio first then comparing against the threshold
security_spec.summary: C operator precedence bug in interrupt preemption/priority-masking logic: '&' binds weaker than '>=' so mask-and-compare without parentheses evaluates mask-threshold comparison first, yielding 0/1 instead of the intended priority field extraction

findings.finding: read_mtopi() correctly reads iprio from env->miprio[irq] without any mask-and-compare precedence risk. The only comparison is 'if (riscv_cpu_default_priority(irq) > IPRIO_DEFAULT_M)' on a separate line with proper parentheses. No vulnerability pattern found.
read_stopi() correctly reads iprio from env->siprio[irq] with comparison on a separate line. No mask-and-compare precedence risk.

read_vstopi() uses siprio[] array with iprio comparison 'if (siprio[s] < iprio)' and 'if (iprio > IPRIO_MMAXIPRIO)' — all comparisons are properly parenthesized and on standalone lines. No operator precedence risk. HVICTL_IPRIOM mask check is separate from comparisons.

IPRIO masking is on a separate line (line 498: 'iprio = aplic->target[irq] & aplic->iprio_mask') before any comparison (line 499: 'if (ithres && iprio >= ithres)'). No operator precedence risk between mask-and-compare.

riscv_imsic_topei() uses eithreshold for determining max_irq loop bound. Priority is the interrupt index i itself (line 60: '(i << IMSIC_TOPEI_IID_SHIFT) | i'), no IPRIO array masking needed. No Smnip preemption threshold comparison.
IPRIO is read from array and compared in 'if (prio <= best_prio)' (line 461) — comparison is properly parenthesized and separate from array access. No mask-and-compare pattern exists.
write_hvipriox() writes iprio[irq] = (val >> (i * 8)) & 0xff (line 5131) — simple byte extraction and assignment without any threshold comparison. No Smnip preemption logic.

rmw_ireg() handles siselect/siprio accesses. The iprio value extraction (line 2524: 'iprio[firq + i] = (new_val >> (IPRIO_IRQ_BITS * i)) & 0xff') is standalone mask extraction, no threshold comparison.
read_hvipriox() reads iprio values from the hviprio array. No threshold comparison or masking pattern vulnerable to operator precedence.
CPU reset initializes iprio arrays (miprio, siprio, hviprio). No mask-and-compare pattern. Simple initial-value assignment with ternary checks.
VMSTATE_UINT8_ARRAY for env->miprio and env->siprio (64 entries each) is present for migration. No mask-and-compare pattern.
